title: 1988 Donruss Red #369 Eric Davis Cincinnati Reds Baseball Card

descriptionText: This is a 1988 Donruss Eric Davis #369 trading card featuring Eric Davis from the Cincinnati Reds in the Major League (MLB). It is a sports trading card part of the Red parallel variety set by Donruss.
